evidence.reason: In advisory posture, `ordinaryAdvisory` is computed for the whole changed set (line 409), so any privileged path makes it false. Lines 429-434 then authorize every `definitionChanges` entry, including non-privileged definition/graph paths such as `tsconfig.json`. Those non-privileged paths should remain advisory annotations under `advisory`, matching the described `policyDiff` behavior; otherwise the same tip can get `pass` from one judge and `needs-human` from the other. This is an existing implementation-scope bug, not a new requirement.
